title: science(toe): localize typed-event collision boundary
science: toe-axiom-closure Block 89 - a two-event critical-pair theorem plus a scheduler-boundary no-selector negative. Three supports are separated and the distinction is shown load-bearing: W_e = 3 Record write sites, L_e = 8 abstract Kraus input/target factors, F_e = 15-site full routed physical footprint. POSITIVE: if the full footprints are disjoint, all 36 unnormalized branch-map pairs commute as an operator identity (K_o^e tensor K_p^f factorization), hence on arbitrary joint inputs including states entangled between the two events and with an external reference; the complete Record / resource / archive / signed-source-edge / reservation ledgers agree in both execution orders, and a no-event branch stays retryable. NEGATIVE (the forcing part): an exhaustive census over all non-identical relative placements with overlapping routed cores across all 24 proper-cubic orientations gives 2365 placements, 2230 simultaneously ready, 2055 Record-write-disjoint, 1134 also abstract-instrument-disjoint - and one pair in that last class, exchanged by the affine involution g(x,y,z) = (x,-y,-z) + (0,0,-1), has disjoint write sets and disjoint abstract supports yet routed cores overlapping on eight sites, with the two 73-primitive core orders each producing 128 sparse terms differing in norm by 0.728431359. So Record-write disjointness AND abstract-Kraus commutation are both insufficient for confluence of the compiled physical word, and the discrepancy occurs before any outcome pointer or Record append (not a sampling effect). Further: all-conflicts-refuse is a finite-range, proper-cubic/translation-covariant confluent scheduler but deadlocks that pair forever, and because the involution swaps the two events the only invariant subsets are the empty set (not maximal) and the full conflicting pair (not conflict-free) - so NO deterministic covariant maximal conflict-free selector exists on that fixture. Four named alternatives remain, all additional law content the current axioms and registered primitives do not select: symmetric stochastic arbitration with its own normalized outcome resource, a locally readable symmetry-breaking context, a merged joint collision instrument, or safe refusal with no liveness claim.
